business_problem: Presidio needed to replace a patchwork of project management tools and manual file sharing that hid timelines, staffing, and equipment needs and gave leaders little visibility into project status.
solution_summary: Presidio built a unified project management portal so more than 150 project managers could stop juggling Microsoft Project desktop files, Excel sheets, and manual document sharing. The objective was to create one cloud-based operating environment where project data, collaboration, reporting, and client communication would live together rather than being scattered across disconnected artifacts. Key components include Microsoft Project for the web, Project Accelerator, Power Apps, Power BI, and Microsoft Teams. Presidio now has one place to manage projects, better continuity when project managers change roles, faster collaboration, and improved leadership visibility into thousands of projects.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Project for the web
solution_components.role: acts as the backbone system for project planning and management

solution_components.name: Project Accelerator
solution_components.role: extends Project for the web with the reusable structure Presidio needed for its portal

solution_components.name: Power Apps
solution_components.role: provides the configurable application layer for the Presidio Project Portal

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: surfaces action items, reporting, and project visibility for managers and leadership

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: supports document sharing, collaboration, and client status communication from the same environment

data_flow: Project managers enter and maintain plans in Project for the web, the P3 portal built with Power Apps captures and preserves related execution data, Power BI exposes status and action items, and Teams distributes documents and updates to internal teams and clients without moving work into separate tools.
business_outcome: Presidio now has one place to manage projects, better continuity when project managers change roles, faster collaboration, and improved leadership visibility into thousands of projects.
architecture_clues: The portal, called P3, is built on the Microsoft Power Platform foundation.
Teams serves as both document repository and collaboration surface depending on client needs.
evidence_quotes: Presidio built the Presidio Project Portal, or P3 for short, using Project for the web with the Project Accelerator add-on as the platform, along with Power Apps, Power BI, and Microsoft Teams integration.
Now that we have a unified system with Project for the web, project managers have one place to manage their projects.
All of the data is preserved and easily accessible.
